Then h*t_hat_k=(2,1)=z_p-bar z_k as in procedure step 3. tau_k=(1,0) is distinct and has positive dot product 2/sqrt(5) with that tangent, compatible with step 2.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The vertical section passes through the predictor, has horizontal previous-orientation normal, and meets the increasing local branch at the labelled selected point.
diagram_math_checks.justification: tau_k^T(z-z_p)=x-2, so H_k is precisely x=2. Substituting x=2 gives y=3/2. With unit-speed positive-x reparameterization c_k, tau_k^T c_k'(u)=dx/du>0; the compact illustrated segment admits a positive lower bound. Step 3 and lem-transverse-hyperplane-selects-unique-local-branch-point establish the general local uniqueness, while the illustrative polynomial verifies the depicted unique forward intersection directly.
